name: Hotel Schwarzer Adler
beschreibung: Hotel Schwarzer Adler is a well-established hotel in Nauders, set at 1,300 metres elevation at the border triangle of Austria, Italy, and Switzerland. Guest rooms reflect cozy alpine craftsmanship with modern amenities. The on-site wellness area offers a Finnish sauna, steam bath, and quiet relaxation lounge. A traditional restaurant serves authentic Tyrolean delicacies. Summer brings boundless hiking and biking trails, while winter connects directly to the Nauders-Bergkastel ski domain.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Schwarzer Adler in Nauders on the Reschen Pass features authentic alpine charm, a Finnish sauna and steam bath, hearty Tyrolean cuisine, and quick access to ski slopes.
